title: AdMob app IDs (Android + iOS)
summary: The App ID in the form `ca-app-pub-…~…` for each platform.
why: The ads SDK crashes at launch without an App ID. Test ads are used during development, but the App ID must be in the manifest/Info.plist from the start.

steps.title: Sign in to AdMob → **Apps → Add app**
Select **Android** as the platform
steps.detail: For “Is the app listed on a supported app store?”, answer **No** if it is not published yet; enter the app name as the name.

steps.title: Copy the Android App ID
steps.detail: On the **App settings** page, in the form `ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX~NNNNNNNNNN`.

steps.title: Repeat the same for **iOS** and copy the iOS App ID
Create and publish the **Privacy & messaging → GDPR** message
steps.detail: A consent form is mandatory for EU/UK users (RULES.md Section 8.3). Add both platforms to the app, then click **Publish**.

fields.label: I created and **published** the GDPR message in AdMob
